name: yorha-legal-ai-frontend
description: YoRHa-styled legal AI frontend with Gemma4 integration - Phase 70 Clean

scripts.gemma4:rotorquant:props: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:8090/v1/models | jq '.data[0] | {id, context_length, llm: .object}'; echo ''
scripts.retrieval:go:test: curl -X POST 'http://localhost:5173/api/retrieval/go' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query": "authentication session", "limit": 10, "includeSummary": true}' | jq '.'
scripts.verify:full: npm run verify:smoke && npm run verify:story && npm run verify:atlas && npm run verify:cubic && npm run verify:verdict
scripts.atlas:phase102:step4:all: npm run atlas:phase102:step4:build && npm run atlas:phase102:step4:score:dry && npm run atlas:phase102:step4:stability
scripts.atlas:phase8:fanout:dry: npm run atlas:phase8:step3:langextract:gate && npm run atlas:summary:index:rank && npm run atlas:summary:envelopes:build:dry && npm run atlas:summary:envelopes:queue:dry && npm run atlas:materialize:feature-envelopes:dry && npm run atlas:phase16:latent:dry && npm run atlas:phase16:som:dry && npm run atlas:phase16:gds:dry && npm run atlas:bitfrost-semantic-cache:warm
scripts.atlas:phase8:fanout:apply: npm run atlas:phase8:step3:langextract:apply && npm run atlas:summary:index:rank:apply && npm run atlas:summary:envelopes:build:apply && npm run atlas:summary:envelopes:queue:apply && npm run atlas:materialize:feature-envelopes:apply && npm run atlas:phase16:latent:apply && npm run atlas:phase16:som:apply && npm run atlas:phase16:gds:apply && npm run atlas:bitfrost-semantic-cache:warm:apply
scripts.graphify:daily: npm run graphify:validate && npm run graphify:materialize:apply && node ../scripts/atlas/daily-graphify-cold-processing.mjs && npm run atlas:phase8:fanout:apply && npm run atlas:qdrant:tag-mirror:apply && npm run atlas:qdrant:feature-map-sync:apply
scripts.graphify:daily:dry: npm run graphify:validate && npm run graphify:materialize:dry && node ../scripts/atlas/daily-graphify-cold-processing.mjs --dry-run && npm run atlas:phase8:fanout:dry && npm run atlas:qdrant:feature-map-sync
scripts.graphify:daily:fast: npm run graphify:validate && npm run graphify:materialize:apply && node ../scripts/atlas/daily-graphify-cold-processing.mjs
scripts.graphify:daily:cold: npm run graphify:daily && npm run graphify:cluster-summaries:skip-llm && npm run graphify:cluster-summaries && npm run atlas:index:full-repo
scripts.atlas:gds:phase8:apply: npm run atlas:gds:pagerank:apply && npm run atlas:gds:louvain:apply
scripts.audit:infrastructure: npm run audit:ports && npm run audit:services && npm run audit:smoke && npm run audit:rpc-tool-calling-db
scripts.audit:infrastructure:verbose: node scripts/atlas/audit-port-contracts.mjs --verbose && node scripts/atlas/generate-service-contract.mjs --verbose && node scripts/atlas/devops-smoke-gan.mjs --verbose && npm run audit:rpc-tool-calling-db:verbose
scripts.atlas:functions:refresh: npm run atlas:functions:index && npm run atlas:functions:backfill:apply
scripts.atlas:functions:summarize: npm run atlas:functions:query:write && npm run atlas:functions:summarize:registry
scripts.atlas:enrichment:full: npm run atlas:audit:summary-quality && npm run atlas:summarize:batch
scripts.atlas:enrichment:full:dry: npm run atlas:audit:summary-quality:dry && npm run atlas:summarize:batch:dry
scripts.gpu:rerank:init: node --loader ts-node/esm -e "import { initializeGPUReranking } from './src/lib/server/gpu/cuda-graph-rerank-hook.js'; await initializeGPUReranking();"
scripts.atlas:packet-parser:smoke: node -e "const p=require('./crates/atlas_packet_parser/wrapper.js'); if(typeof p.parseLargeJsonToMsgpack!=='function') process.exit(1); console.log('atlas packet parser ready')"
scripts.atlas:gate:repair:neo4j: npm run atlas:gate:repair:neo4j:coords:apply && npm run atlas:gate:repair:neo4j:identity
scripts.atlas:gate:repair:neo4j:apply: npm run atlas:gate:repair:neo4j:coords:apply && npm run atlas:gate:repair:neo4j:identity --apply
scripts.atlas:gate:repair:neo4j:verbose: npm run atlas:gate:repair:neo4j:coords:apply --verbose && npm run atlas:gate:repair:neo4j:identity --apply --verbose
scripts.atlas:1b:all:dry: echo '🔍 Phase 1B — Running all repairs (dry-run mode)' && npm run atlas:1b:clustering-health && npm run atlas:1b:postgres-indexes && npm run atlas:1b:qdrant-payload:dry && npm run atlas:1b:cache-audit
scripts.atlas:1b:all:apply: echo '🔄 Phase 1B — Running all repairs (apply mode - REQUIRES CONFIRMATION)' && npm run atlas:1b:clustering-health && npm run atlas:1b:postgres-indexes && npm run atlas:1b:qdrant-payload:apply && npm run atlas:1b:cache-audit
scripts.phase85:full-pipeline: npm run manifold:hilbert:sort:57k && npm run cuda:graph:capture:representative && npm run pagerank:neo4j:apply && npm run pagerank:mapreduce:gpu && npm run cache:warm:all
